terminals.name: Expo dev server
terminals.description: Metro bundler / Expo dev server for the NearMatch app. Press 'w' to open on web (installs react-dom + react-native-web on first use) or scan the QR code with Expo Go. Reads EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from the environment or a local .env file.
